text:
tia: Quick update: releasing community-plugins v0.9.0 today and announcing the Maintainers Summit next month. v0.9 adds plugin scaffolds, a lightweight autorun test, and clearer governance docs. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-plugins/releases/tag/v0.9.0 :party:
harry: Nice! Is the summit open to external maintainers or internal only?
tia: Open to external maintainers and heavy contributors. Were reserving a few sponsor slots for orgs to send folks. Summit date: Nov 14, two half-days. Registration in the release notes.
sana: Will there be a plugin compatibility matrix? We need to know which runtime versions are supported for the new scaffolds.
tia: Yes  added COMPATIBILITY.md in the release. Supports runtime v2.1+ with notes for pinned deps.
doc-bot: Reminder: Please check CONTRIBUTING.md updates and the new governance template before onboarding new maintainers.
release-bot: Released: community-plugins v0.9.0 by @tia  assets: tarball, changelog, COMPATIBILITY.md, governance template. https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-plugins/releases/tag/v0.9.0
harry: Are we offering travel grants for external maintainers?
tia: We have a small travel fund and a handful of remote stipend spots. Apply via the summit form in the release notes. Priority to active maintainers and early community contributors.
sana: I can host a breakout on CI best practices for plugins. Count me in.
tia: Amazing, adding you to the agenda. Also tagging maintainers to nominate speakers and lightning talks.
release-bot: Note: v0.9.0 includes a minor security guidance doc for third-party plugin verification.
tia: Thanks everyone. Please RT the release and nominate maintainers for the summit. Well send calendar invites next week. :sparkles:
